name: general_qa
description: Mixed-domain question/document benchmark with 10 documents and 8 queries.
documents: Distributed systems require explicit reasoning about failure modes including network partitions, slow downstreams, and partial failures. Patterns like circuit breakers and bulkheads isolate damage.
Embedding models map text to fixed-dimensional vectors. Choices range from compact CPU-friendly models like MiniLM to long-context hosted APIs like OpenAI's text-embedding-3-large.
Code review hierarchy: architectural fit first, correctness second, readability third, performance fourth, style last. Style should be enforced by tooling.
Customer feedback this quarter focused on onboarding friction. Engineering response addressed export streaming and the SSO redesign is in progress.
Financial reporting: ARR grew 23 percent year over year. Net revenue retention was 118 percent. Gross margin held at 78 percent.
Patient encounter for chronic lower back pain. MRI revealed L4-L5 disc herniation. Conservative management with physical therapy and NSAIDs initiated.
Marketing campaign delivered 312 leads in March, up from 198 in February. CPC dropped from 14.20 to 11.85 dollars.
Engineering hire: Welcome Jenna Park to the platform team. She will focus on observability tooling.
Security update reminder: rotate service-account credentials by end of week. Runbook is in the security-rotations Slack channel.
Data center upgrade in Frankfurt completed without incident. Latency improvements averaged 18 percent across common API routes.

queries.query: How are distributed system failures handled?
What's the right priority order in code review?
What treatment plan was set for the back pain?
Did marketing leads improve this month?
